summary: Answered capability question: current built-in ChatGPT tools here do not include a native text/image-to-3D generative model that outputs arbitrary production-ready 3D assets. However, ChatGPT can create simple/parametric 3D files programmatically (for example OBJ/STL/GLB in suitable cases) and provide a direct sandbox download link to files it creates. For realistic image-to-3D or advanced textured/rigged assets, an external specialized 3D generator/tool would still be needed.
